_comment: Declared exceptions for scripts/check.py. Everything here is a deliberate,
reviewable decision -- widening any list should show up in a diff.
The size contract (~300 lines / ~2,500 words / 15 KB) applies to every
hardening/10-docs-system-screening.md), `frozen` below is empty, and the
'Legacy ... (frozen)' paragraphs that once declared the contract were
removed on 2026-09-17 (roadmap 19, Phase 0). Its prose home is
stays as the mechanism: should a file ever be frozen again, its entry
names the README paragraph that declares it (see `frozen_sections`).

frozen_sections._comment: The paragraph, in each index, that declares files frozen. The frozen-decl check reads from this marker to the next blank line and looks for each entry's `token` INSIDE that paragraph -- searching the whole README would match the index table instead and certify nothing. Empty since 2026-09-17: the two declaring paragraphs were removed when nothing was frozen any more; add a marker here together with any future `frozen` entry.

status_vocab_only._comment: Tables status-vocab reads in addition to status_tables and status-sync does not: their Status cells use the legend, but their links land on the record anchor of the decision (often a bullet under a DONE heading), so the first-body-line comparison status-sync makes would be false disagreement. decisions-index checks these rows' anchors and triggers instead.

heading_status_baseline._comment: Headings that carried a status word or a date when the heading-status check landed (2026-09-11). The contract froze headings at birth; these predate it and are live link targets, so they are not rewritten (that would break inbound anchors). Per-file counts may only go DOWN -- when a legacy file is split (the explicitly requested pass), its entry goes away.

root_entry_files._comment: The entry files, each with its line cap (0 = none), read by claude-md (restated facts) and root-entry (shape). AGENTS.md is the canonical entry file since 2026-09-17 (roadmap 19, Phase 1); CLAUDE.md is its one-line `@AGENTS.md` import.

root_entry_forbidden._comment: Shape rules for the entry files (the root-entry check); restated facts are claude_md_forbidden's. Digits before a slash catch both an NN/NN count and a 17/09 pointer -- the entry file links, it never cites.

doc_lag._comment: doc-lag (report only; --strict fails): the newest code commit is more than max_commits code commits or max_days days past the newest docs/ commit.

decisions_index._comment: decisions-index: every DROPPED/DEFERRED entry under scope needs a row in index whose link lands on its heading. The index is the README only (its 01-settled.md child holds the DONE-by-decision rows, which the check does not read).

design_no_history._comment: design-no-history: the compiled layer describes the present. SKIPs while the folder does not exist (roadmap 19 Phase 3 creates it). Case-insensitive regexes.

heading_hierarchy_baseline._comment: Split residue grandfathered per file when heading-hierarchy landed (2026-09-17): a ### directly under the H1, or a second heading repeating the H1. Counts may only go DOWN; Phase 5 of roadmap 19 removed the roadmap entries (2026-09-18) and Phase 6 the command_reference ones (2026-09-20). Empty since; it stays empty.

stale_paths_baseline._comment: Prose and link text still naming NN-slug.md where NN-slug/ is a folder, grandfathered per file when stale-paths landed (2026-09-17). Counts may only go DOWN; Phase 5 of roadmap 19 retargeted the roadmap entries (2026-09-18) and Phase 6 the command_reference ones (2026-09-20). Empty since; it stays empty.

usage_in_record._comment: usage-in-record (report only): a table in the record whose header has one of these columns is a copy of the usage contract.

size_baseline._comment: Files already over a cap when the gate landed (2026-09-10). The check fails if one GROWS on any axis, or if any unlisted file CROSSES a cap. To add content anyway, edit the number here in the same commit -- the diff is the point. This list should only ever shrink. Empty since 2026-09-18: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md left it when roadmap 19 Phase 3 split it into docs/design/; the quality-inspection report, roadmap/README.md, 17/04 and 17/05 when Phase 5 split or condensed them -- every page is under the cap.

semantic_lint_runs._comment: Where /docs-semantic-lint writes its runs. The owner's command (~/.claude/commands/, outside every repo) is one file for DualC and Boletus alike; the only per-repo fact it needs -- this folder -- is read from here instead of being hardcoded in the command (roadmap 19/07, decision D-41). The folder is also an index root; the `semantic-lint-runs` check keeps the two in step and every run named NN-<date>-<slug>.md with its date on the first body line.

out_of_repo_links._comment: Relative links that deliberately leave the repo. They resolve only where the sibling project is checked out, so they are reported as informational, never as broken.

structure_summarized_prefixes._comment: Directories STRUCTURE.md documents with a one-line summary instead of file-by-file. Listing one here is a decision, not a silent widening. Since 2026-09-17 (roadmap 19, Phase 1) each docs/ folder is one line: its README is the file-by-file index, and STRUCTURE.md had been repeating the indexes line for line.
structure_summarized_prefixes.scripts/check_fixtures/: one line; miniature pass/fail trees for `check.py --selftest`, one pair per docs check
